description.text: The third expansion pack of the ★neo series, released in Japan on 23 November 2000 and themed on Ecruteak City. It holds the legendary Raikou, Entei, Suicune and Ho-Oh and the mythical Celebi, so with it all 100 Pokémon new to Gold and Silver had appeared in the game. It also brought in Shining Pokémon, based on the games' rare differently colored Pokémon; here they are Shining Magikarp and Shining Gyarados. Its English counterpart is Neo Revelation, released in 2001.
